policy: Count distinct artist + title per group from distribution_agency credits across all chart years. Genie/Stone is an analytical alliance, not a claim that CJ owns Genie. Direct recorded credits take precedence over general artist partnerships. International agreements require evidence covering the recording, territory and period; no blanket Sony/Warner/Universal reassignment. Songs can appear in multiple groups across historical credits. Unmapped credits are excluded only from this chart, never deleted from the CSV.

agreement_review.decision: Do not assign all Sony credits to Kakao. The announcement concerns IVE and North American activities; none of the Sony-credited artist/title pairs in this CSV are IVE.

YG PLUS explicitly lists HYBE, YG, THEBLACKLABEL and VLAST partnerships. Their rows already credited YG PLUS are included. Do not overwrite historical Dreamus or other distributor credits merely from artist affiliation.
Excluded: the Dreamus distribution agreement ended in 2025. The old 2022 partnership is insufficient for a current blanket mapping.
Combined per the requested CJ ENM alliance definition. Genie's own distribution portal lists separate Genie Music and CJ ENM (STONE MUSIC) contract contacts.

Warner, Universal, Interpark, NHN Bugs, Chemical Records, Danal, Blending and Music Brothers remain unassigned: no reviewed evidence establishes that the particular credited recordings belong to one of the four distribution groups. Missing evidence is not a claim that no agreement exists.
